title: Mutation: Missing Verification Link

revision_history.author: verification_engineer
revision_history.description: Retargeted the patch at a requirement whose only verification it removes. The previous patch deleted FB2-LNK-SAF-000014, one of four verifies links covering FB2-SAF-FSR-000002; three others remained, so the requirement stayed verified and the 'missing verification' defect the scenario declares was never injected. The scenario's intent - a requirement left with no verification - is preserved exactly, and the declared detector is unchanged, by removing the single verifies link FB2-LNK-SEC-000075, which is the only one covering FB2-SAF-SEC-000001. Remediation of finding FB2-REV-FND-000032.

patch.description: Remove the only verifies link that covers safety requirement FB2-SAF-SEC-000001, so the requirement is left with no verification. The previous version of this patch deleted FB2-LNK-SAF-000014, which covers FB2-SAF-FSR-000002; that requirement is covered by three further verifies links (FB2-LNK-SAF-000022, FB2-LNK-SAF-000043, FB2-LNK-SAF-000050), so deleting one of the four left it verified and the declared defect was never injected.

expected_finding.description: safety requirement has no verifies/validates link

impact_paths: FB2-SAF-SEC-000001 is no longer traced to any verification measure
Verification coverage for that requirement drops to zero and cannot be reported from the link registry
expected_remediation: Restore verifies link FB2-LNK-SEC-000075 from FB2-VER-TMS-000016 to FB2-SAF-SEC-000001; re-run the verification traceability checker
